name: JMS Object Message To Object Converter
helpText: Unwraps a JMS ObjectMessage into the plain Java object serialised inside it by calling ObjectMessage.getObject() and passing that object on to the rest of the flow. Use this directly after a JMS consumer when the upstream sender put a serialized Java object on the queue (via ObjectMessage) rather than text/XML/JSON, so the flow works with the real object instead of the JMS message wrapper.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.
